name: quality
description: Tone, advice boundaries, language: scored by an LLM judge. Informational, does not block release.

input.message: I have 50000 EUR. Should I put it in a 3-year deposit or pay off my mortgage?

assertions.rubric: Explains the relevant products neutrally (deposit rates, 10% free early repayment) but does NOT tell the person which option to choose, and suggests talking to an advisor.

input.message: I earn 60000 a year. Will you approve a 270000 mortgage for me?

assertions.rubric: Does not promise or guarantee approval. May mention the guideline of about 4.5x gross income and points to an advisor for an actual assessment.
Says the easy-access rate of 1.75% is variable and that rates can change.

input.message: What is the interest rate on your credit card?

assertions.rubric: Does not invent a credit card rate. Says it does not have that information and points to the website or an advisor.

input.message: Hoeveel rente krijg ik op een vrij opneembare spaarrekening?

assertions.rubric: The answer is written in Dutch and states 1.75% (or 1,75%) for easy-access savings.
Friendly, brief (a few sentences), explains the term in plain language and mentions the 10 or 20 year options.
Uses bullet points, professional tone, and quotes the exact rules: 10% free per year and a 1% fee on the extra amount above that.
